intro: Torn between Phuket and Pattaya? Here is an honest, side-by-side comparison so you can pick the one that fits your trip — or fit both in.

blocks.html: Short answer: Choose Phuket for better beaches and sea, world-class island tours like Phi Phi and Similan, and beachfront luxury (but you fly south). Choose Pattaya for a beach trip close to Bangkok (~2h drive), cheaper prices, big nightlife and lots of activities.

blocks.text: Phuket vs Pattaya at a glance

items: Pick Phuket if you want nicer sea, world-class island tours and varied beachfront stays
Pick Pattaya if you want a beach trip close to Bangkok, cheaper, with big nightlife and activities
Mind the travel — Phuket needs a flight; Pattaya is a drive from Bangkok, great for short trips

faq.q: Phuket or Pattaya — which is better?
faq.a: Phuket has far nicer sea and world-class island tours for a real beach holiday, while Pattaya is close to Bangkok, cheaper and big on nightlife — ideal for a short trip or weekend escape.

faq.q: Where should I go for nice beaches?
faq.a: Phuket wins on beaches and sea, especially the west/south coast and Phi Phi/Similan tours. Pattaya’s city beach is average — for nicer water you take a boat to Koh Larn.

faq.q: For a short trip from Bangkok, which is better?
faq.a: Pattaya suits short trips better — just a ~2-hour drive from Bangkok with no flight needed — while Phuket requires flying south, so it is better when you have several days.
